input.portfolio_risk_source: Optional M123 paper portfolio risk-state JSON

within_limits.description: New pending paper execution intents are allowed normally.

monitor.description: New pending paper execution intents are allowed but quantity and local margin estimates are reduced by the configured monitor multiplier.

reduce_risk.description: New paper entry intents are recorded as blocked_by_portfolio_risk_state and are not consumable by the paper router.

unknown.description: Unknown or malformed risk state fails closed.

safety.description: M124 only gates and records paper execution intents before simulated paper routing. It does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
